output.content: I opened the model registry last Tuesday and pulled the latest inference logs for the fraud detection pipeline. I sat at my desk with a printed spreadsheet and a highlighter. I marked every row where the feature variance exceeded the threshold. I compared those marks against the manual checklist taped to my monitor. I spent forty minutes cross-referencing each flagged entry with the raw data dumps stored on the local server. I did not run any scripts. I did not trigger any automated alerts. I simply watched the clock tick while I copied the results into a shared document. The process ended when I closed the laptop and walked to the break room. No system generated a summary. No tool validated the input. It was just me and the paper.
output.reclassify_reason: The text is a purely descriptive narrative of a manual process and explicitly states the absence of any decisions, wishes, or trade-offs.
